decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - This development must be completed before 30 May 2019.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (45/AR/04PA, 45/AR/03PA, 45/AR/02PA, 45/AR/01PA) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 3 - You must notify the Council that you have completed the work no later than 21 days after doing so, giving the name of the developer, the address of the property where the extension is and the date of completion.

Condition : 4 - The materials used on the external surfaces of the development shall match those used in the building to which it is attached in terms of style, colour, texture and, in the case of brickwork, bonding, coursing and pointing.

Condition : 5 - The extension hereby approved shall be used solely as part of the house known as 45 Alexandra Road and shall not be occupied as a separate dwelling nor used for business purposes and the premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.

Condition : 6 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Ground floor rear extension 8 metres deep, maximum height of 3.5 metres, 3 metres high to the eaves
